title: Beyond Pretrends: A Discordance-Based Sensitivity Analysis for Difference-in-Differences
abstract: arXiv:2609.19081v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In the canonical Difference-in-Differences design, the control group's post-treatment change serves as an imputation of the treated group's counterfactual change in the same period, an imputation justified by parallel trends. However, differences in group composition can produce between-group differences in how outcomes would evolve over time, rendering this imputation vulnerable to confounding. An alternative imputation -- such as one based on the treated group's pre-treatment change -- avoids such between-group confounding but introduces the risk of confounding from within-group temporal shifts. Ideally, both imputations, each vulnerable to different sources of confounding, would have concordant values, thereby yielding the same causal conclusions. translated_title: 超越前趋势检验：一种基于不一致性的双重差分敏感性分析方法
translated_abstract: 在经典的双重差分设计中，对照组的处理后变化被用作处理组同期反事实变化的插补值，这一插补的合理性由平行趋势假设保证。然而，群体构成的差异可能导致两组结果随时间演变方式上出现组间差异，使这种插补容易受到混淆因素的影响。另一种插补方法——例如基于处理组处理前变化的插补——虽然可以避免这种组间混淆，但会引入组内时间变化带来的混淆风险。理想情况下，这两种各自易受不同混淆源影响的插补值应当相互一致，从而得出相同的因果结论。当两种插补值不一致时，基于平行趋势假设得出的结论就更加依赖该假设本身，因为采用其他插补方法会指向不同的结果。然而在这些情况下……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于“不一致性”的敏感性分析方法，通过比较基于平行趋势的插补估计与基于处理组前期变化的替代插补估计之间的差异，来检验双重差分设计的因果结论对平行趋势假设的依赖程度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a discordance-based sensitivity analysis for difference-in-differences designs that assesses how causal conclusions under parallel trends hinge on that assumption by comparing estimates from alternative imputations that are each vulnerable to different sources of confounding.
